headline: Down 38% from its high, still a Buy consensus
chart_note: 52-week range: $65.08 - $124.86 (post-split adjusted). Currently $77.40, about 38% below its high.
why_today: Netflix shares have slid roughly 38% from their 52-week high, a notable pullback for a name that spent much of the last two years grinding higher on password-sharing crackdowns and ad-tier growth. Despite the drawdown, 36 of 51 covering analysts still rate it a Buy.
pro_1: Still a majority-Buy stock (71% of analysts) even after the pullback, at a PE of just 23.9x versus its own recent history
pro_2: Large, profitable, and diversified across originals, live sports, and an ad-supported tier
con_1: A 38% drawdown from highs signals real investor concern - content spend, competition, or growth deceleration
con_2: Streaming competition keeps intensifying, pressuring both subscriber growth and pricing power
